backend_plan.api_routing: Use same-origin /api routes through the same VM200 bridge to CT203.
backend_plan.cors: If backend enforces allowed origins, add buddieswhostudy.com origins; otherwise same-origin /api should not require CORS.
backend_plan.login: Existing login should work with host-scoped cookies on buddieswhostudy.com after cutover.

apex.note: If using Cloudflare Tunnel public hostnames, add buddieswhostudy.com -> same service as alexhartel.com. If using DNS-only records, use the same target pattern as current public route, with Cloudflare proxy enabled if appropriate.
apex.recommended_cloudflare_record_or_public_: Route to the same Cloudflare Tunnel/service currently serving alexhartel.com.

cloudflare_dns_plan.preferred_initial_behavior: Both apex and www serve the same closed-beta app.

www.recommended_first_cutover: Route to the same closed-beta app.
www.recommended_later: After stable, optionally redirect www to apex.

email_domain_plan.recommendation: Do not send beta invitations from buddieswhostudy.com until SPF/DKIM/DMARC are verified.

go_no_go.reason_r8k_not_yet: Need exact route authority confirmation because R8H VM200/PVEW SSH inventory timed out.

google_oauth_plan.current_known_issue: Google appDataFolder proof previously required adding alexhartel179@gmail.com as a test user.
google_oauth_plan.testing_user_status: Keep beta/test users configured until OAuth app publishing decision.

hard_preconditions_before_any_mutation: Existing login opens and account creation is unavailable in UI.
A rollback target for current DNS/Cloudflare records is recorded.
Current Cloudflare tunnel/public-hostname routing is confirmed, either through VM200/PVEW SSH or Cloudflare dashboard.
Google OAuth JavaScript origins are updated or a temporary no-GoogleSync warning is accepted.
Email sending domain decision is made before public invitations are sent.

mutation_sequence_after_approval.description: Confirm active Cloudflare zone, DNS records, tunnel public hostnames, and VM200 nginx behavior. No mutation.
Add or adjust Cloudflare DNS/public hostname routing for buddieswhostudy.com and www.buddieswhostudy.com to the same VM200 closed-beta app route as alexhartel.com.
mutation_sequence_after_approval.rollback: Restore previous DNS/public-hostname records captured in R8J.

mutation_sequence_after_approval.description: Verify https://buddieswhostudy.com and https://www.buddieswhostudy.com serve the closed-beta app, login modal works, and /api/auth/register returns 403.
Add https://buddieswhostudy.com and https://www.buddieswhostudy.com to Google OAuth authorized JavaScript origins for Profile GoogleSync.
Prepare sender/reply-to domain for buddieswhostudy.com with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC before outbound beta email.
Replace product-facing alexhartel.com hardcoded links with buddieswhostudy.com where appropriate, while leaving admin/internal docs alone.
Plan alexhartel.com as portfolio/projects site after product domain is stable.

r8j_recommended_read_only_step.name: R8J route authority confirmation
r8j_recommended_read_only_step.purpose: Confirm whether buddieswhostudy cutover should be done in Cloudflare DNS records, Cloudflare Tunnel public hostnames, VM200 nginx server_name, or some combination.
r8j_recommended_read_only_step.why_required: R8H public DNS/HTTP worked, but VM200/PVEW SSH timed out, so the exact active tunnel route was not confirmed from host config.

rollback_plan.dns_tunnel: Remove buddieswhostudy.com and www.buddieswhostudy.com Cloudflare records/public-hostname routes or restore captured prior records.
rollback_plan.frontend_backend: Closed-beta gate remains safe; no rollback needed for account-creation blocking unless beta opens.
rollback_plan.vm200_nginx: Restore previous nginx config and reload only if nginx was changed.

vm200_nginx_plan.if_default_server_handles_all_hosts: No nginx server_name change required for first cutover.
vm200_nginx_plan.if_server_name_is_restrictive: Add buddieswhostudy.com and www.buddieswhostudy.com to the wrapper UI server block, then nginx -t and reload only after approval.
